subject: HANDOFF: semantic content freshness + launcher/native continuity arbitration
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=reviewer-launcher-content-continuity-gen2-20261001. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=FINAL_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; production main did not move. Reconciled live with Gen3 alpha1 checkpoint: primary already owns stable capture admission/newest-STARTED fencing, exact visual ownership, Shizuku authority revocation, and opening live-content attach. This handoff is additive: exact-cycle provenance still lacks SEMANTIC CONTENT FRESHNESS. Strongest source evidence: FrameStore eligibility is cycle+dimensions+age; coordinator allows frozen frames up to 10s; DisplayMirrorHost chooses eligible frozen content before live mirror; accessibility callback currently does not invalidate content context. Proposed integration: stable ContentContextTracker monotonic revision; capturePurpose PRIME versus VISUAL_REFRESH; current visual frozen eligibility requires current cycle + newest-started sequence + current contextRevision + field-measured freshness policy; semantic dirtiness/newer refresh makes older frozen pixels ineligible immediately; use live SurfaceControl mirror while refresh is unresolved; reject refresh completion if context changed; never revive a known-dirty same-cycle frame after refresh failure. Preserve existing thresholds and all adjacent owner models. Launcher contract: do not automate One UI Home or move the real task; Samsung's documented Z Fold7 Cover screen mirroring is the native layout-sync mechanism and should be validated ON/OFF during field testing. Model passed 15/15 + deterministic 100k events, including correction of an initially missed newest-started fence. V2 artifact supersedes the earlier pre-alpha1-reconciliation handoff/package in the same artifact folder. Device validation and manual primary integration review required; no production GitHub writes.
